reason: An ACP integration server that lets Zed and other IDEs operate DeepSeek Harness agents, including agent sessions, tool calls, terminal output, diffs, planning updates, and user elicitation.

summaries.zh: 通过 ACP 协议将 Zed 等 IDE 连接到 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，支持会话管理、工具调用、终端输出、代码差异和计划更新。
summaries.en: Connects Zed and other IDEs to DeepSeek Harness agents over ACP, with session management, tool calls, terminal output, code diffs, and plan updates.

capabilities: Bridges IDE clients to dsh agents over ACP JSON-RPC
Streams agent messages, thoughts, tool calls, diffs, and context usage
Supports agent session history, presets, model selection, and thinking settings
Renders terminal command output and exit codes
Supports agent-driven file edits and user-question elicitation
Uses configured dsh credentials and model provider settings
